keyword: will i be able to see artemis reentry
claims: Artemis II is scheduled to splash down off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026, around 5 p.m. Pacific time.
NASA will provide a live broadcast on YouTube, NASA+, and other streaming platforms like Netflix and HBO Max starting around 3:30 p.m. PT.
The capsule will re-enter the atmosphere at approximately 24,000 mph as it returns from the Moon.
